model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training reward performance of two methods—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on Easy and Hard training sets, respectively. In both plots, the x-axis represents “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 with major tick marks at intervals of 100, and the y-axis represents “Training Rewards,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot. In the “Easy Training Set” plot, the blue line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts near 0.0, rises steeply to about 0.2 by step 100, then gradually increases to approximately 0.35 by step 500, with a shaded confidence region around it. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) follows a similar trajectory, beginning near 0.0, reaching ~0.2 by step 100, and stabilizing around 0.38–0.40 by step 500, also with a shaded region. In the “Hard Training Set” plot, the blue line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) begins near 0.0, rises slightly to ~0.03 by step 50, then declines to near 0.0 by step 100 and remains flat thereafter. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts near 0.0, climbs to ~0.05 by step 50, continues rising with fluctuations to ~0.15 by step 300, and peaks near 0.20 by step 500, again with a shaded confidence band. Both plots use solid lines with no markers and include gridlines for reference.
